subject: SIG/CAIQ evidence request: personnel attestation, redacted checks, and training records
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acme-retail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up: evidence needed for personnel controls

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. As part of our SIG assessment (we're consolidating CAIQ responses), the Acme security team needs a few items from Redwood related to employee vetting and training:

• Background check policy and either a small set (2-3) of redacted sample results or a vendor attestation stating checks are performed and scope.
• Training completion records for role-based security training and privacy awareness for the past 12 months (redacted employee IDs or masked emails are fine).
• The onboarding and offboarding checklist that shows how access is provisioned and revoked (including timeline for deprovisioning).
• Any SOC 2 mapping or attestations that reference personnel controls.

We'd like to collect these artifacts by EOD 2025-07-15 to keep our audit timeline. If any files require an NDA or DocuSign attestation before sharing (e.g., unredacted samples), please flag that.

Can you provide a point of contact and an estimated delivery plan?

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Retail
[Attachment: acme_SIG_questionnaire_v2.docx]

Lisa,

I can coordinate delivery. Looping in Marissa (People Ops) and David (Security) to assemble and confirm redaction. High-level plan below:

• Marissa will prepare the onboarding/offboarding checklist and a redacted sample of background checks (we'll provide attestation if samples are not permitted).
• David will export the training completion log (redacted identifiers) and the SOC 2 personnel-controls mapping.
• We'll stage items in a secure Drive folder and provide a DocuSign attestation if required.

Target: initial bundle to you by 2025-07-10, final delivery by 2025-07-14 to meet your 7/15 acceptance window. If you need an earlier slice or a different scope (e.g., 6 months of training instead of 12), let us know.

— Priya Natarajan

Hi Lisa / team,

Quick status from People Ops: attached is the draft onboarding_offboarding_checklist.xlsx and a single redacted background sample (background_checks_sample_redacted.pdf). Notes:
• The sample has names and SSNs redacted per our vendor contract; we replaced with employee IDs (RID-XXXX) to show matching process flows.
• Our standard background scope: identity verification, national criminal check (where permitted), and employment history verification. We use CheckSafe (vendor) for US hires and follow local law for international hires.
• If Acme requires vendor-signed attestation instead of samples, we can request a signed attestation from CheckSafe; that usually takes ~5 business days.

Let me know if redaction is sufficient or if you need a signed vendor attestation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up: evidence needed for personnel controls

Marissa — thanks for the checklist and redacted sample, that helps. A couple of quick clarifications from our security team:

• Can you confirm the deprovisioning timeline for terminated employees (how long until cloud IAM and SSO access are revoked)? Please include any automated vs manual steps.
• For background checks, we typically accept redacted samples but will need a vendor attestation if the sample doesn't show full scope. If possible, please request the attestation from CheckSafe.
• Also, can you provide training completion broken down by role (engineer, sales, ops) for the last 12 months? Redacted IDs are fine.

We can accept the initial bundle via secure Drive link and we will sign any required DocuSign attestation. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lisa

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up: evidence needed for personnel controls

Lisa / Priya,

Attaching the training_completion_log_2024-2025.csv (IDs redacted) and a short personnel_controls_mapping_SOC2.pdf that maps our SOC 2 controls to SIG/CAIQ personnel questions. Key points:
• Security training is role-based and required on hire + annual refresh; engineers have additional secure-coding modules.
• Deprovisioning: SSO revocation is automated via HR event; application-level keys/tokens are revoked within 1 business day by automation (exceptions logged). See checklist for manual approvals.
• We enforce least privilege and run quarterly access reviews for privileged groups.

Staging files in a shared Drive folder (link below). If you need a DocuSign attestation, Priya, please send the envelope link and we'll have Legal sign.

-David
